id.description: Full patent number used as the tab name, e.g. JP0000000, US5946647.

number.description: As printed, e.g. 特許第0000000号, US 5,946,647.

status.description: Legal status with where and when it was read.

source.description: URL the text was taken from.

origLang.description: Language of the claims; decides how line breaks join words.

summary.description: Summary sections, each a verbatim text file whose first line is its heading.
